result.title: DDxBasis: Explaining Frozen Foundation Encoder-based Medical Classification by Exact Differential Diagnosis
result.summary: In differential diagnosis (DDx), a clinician explains a diagnosis by the few findings that separate it from the alternatives. Medical image classifiers cannot yet explain themselves this way. Existing explanations are either faithful but spread over hundreds of concepts, or compact but leave part of each decision unexplained. We present DDxBasis, which explains a classifier on a frozen foundation encoder as a differential diagnosis in three steps. First, a concept bottleneck reads all patch tokens at every encoder layer using gated, second-order slot attention. A concept basis then regroups the concepts into two-pole axes, each a differential between groups of diagnoses. Finally, we read a differential diagnosis from each axis through the typical presentation of its poles, the pertinent findings of the case, and counterfactual edits of borderline cases. Across five medical datasets, DDxBasis is the most accurate frozen-encoder model and close to the best published domain-specific results. Because every concept adds its own evidence, its reproducible concept basis splits each decision exactly, at no cost in accuracy. Without ordered stage or concept labels, the axes recover cell lineages and rare subtypes, agree with dermatologists' structure annotations, and expose planted and real shortcuts.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 DDxBasis，用门控二阶 slot attention 在冻结医学基础编码器的每层读取 patch token 构建概念瓶颈，再将概念重组为双极鉴别轴，从轴的两极典型表现、本例相关发现和边界病例反事实编辑中读出「鉴别诊断」式解释。
AI.relevance_reason: 其把决策精确拆分到可核查概念证据、并以反事实编辑验证的做法，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选、latent 内容贡献分配与忠实性评价提供可供核查的线索；但对象是医学图像分类而非 VLM 生成式推理，联系需进一步确认。
